Notice issued by this Court to
respondent on 02.12.2021 was returned

respondent was never posted as Branch
Manager in the concerned Bank.
Thereafter, the m atter was listed on
27.03.2023 and petitioner was granted

parties. On 21.04.2023, adjournm ent

impleading newly im pleaded respondent

2. I n view of the last order, this Court

3. Accordingly, contempt petition is
closed. However, petitioner shall be at
